about: Shared components for mod wikis and websites. The ui directory holds ui.css and ui.js. The base stylesheet holds the tokens and base components. Add them to a site with `python3 create.py --dest <site>/public/assets/ui`.
head: <link rel="stylesheet" href="./assets/base.css">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="./assets/ui/ui.css">
<script type="module" src="./assets/ui/ui.js"></script>
rules: Use the shared components before adding page-specific CSS. Add reusable parts to ui-library.
Spacing uses the tokens --s1 to --s8, or a token less 1px under a border (docs/LAYOUT.md). Line heights are multiples of 8.
Colours come from base.css: --foreground, --muted, --border, --focus. Elements read them at draw time.
No rounded corners, shadows, gradients or icons. Pressed or current things are underlined (text) or outlined (buttons).
Text in parts follows docs/WRITING.md: short, exact, no hype.

components.name: button
components.use: An action that isn't a link: Play, Copy, Reset. aria-pressed="true" for one that's on.
components.avoid: Navigation (use a link) and picking one of a few views (use toggle).

components.name: toggle
components.use: Picking one of a few views, filters or versions. Set aria-pressed on each button and update it in your script.
components.avoid: More than about six choices (use a select in a field).

components.name: badge
components.use: A short value beside a name: a key, a tempo, a version. style="--ui-tone:#hex" colours it.
components.avoid: Sentences, and colour as the only way to tell values apart.

components.name: keycap
components.use: A key in running text or a Keys table.
components.avoid: Keys the browser keeps, like Ctrl+Tab.

components.name: stats
components.use: A few numbers that matter, each with a short label: results, sizes, counts.
components.avoid: More than five, or numbers that need a sentence to make sense.

components.name: field
components.use: A labelled text box, select or text area.
components.avoid: Placeholder text in place of a label.

components.name: compare-table
components.use: Two or three versions side by side, row by row. Put it in .table-wrap.
components.avoid: One column of data (use a plain table).

components.name: details
components.use: Something most readers skip: a long list, the steps for a rare case.

components.name: wave
components.use: One sound, with its waveform: click to seek, Play or Space to play.
components.avoid: Several versions of one sound (use compare).

components.name: compare
components.use: Versions of one sound, heard from the same moment: before and after a change. Space plays, 1 to 9 pick.

attributes.name: audio[data-label]
attributes.desc: Each version's name, in a child audio element.

attributes.name: audio[data-regions]
attributes.desc: Seconds to shade in that version.

components.name: plot
components.use: A handful of numbers to compare at a glance: per bar, per run, per version. band marks the range that's fine.
components.avoid: Exact values someone will read off (use a table), and more than about 60 points.

attributes.name: band
attributes.desc: The range that's fine; values past it draw muted.

attributes.name: unit
attributes.desc: After each axis number, like ms.

components.name: copy
components.use: A command or snippet people paste: a Copy button on its code block.
components.avoid: Code people read rather than run.

components.name: tabs
components.use: Switch between instructions for different loaders or platforms. The radio controls work without JavaScript.
components.example:
Put the jar in mods.

Put the NeoForge build in mods.

components.name: soon
components.use: Show a pending store listing with its review date.
components.example: CurseForge in review

components.name: actions
components.use: Put downloads and source links together below the lead.

components.name: meta
components.use: Show a short lead and supporting metadata such as an update date.
components.example:
Old and new transitions, side by side.

components.name: callout
components.use: Highlight a requirement or a brief note alongside the instructions.
components.example:
Client only

Install the mod on your client. Servers can run without it.

components.name: breadcrumbs
components.use: Show where a page sits in a documentation hierarchy.

components.name: progress
components.use: Show a known amount of work completed.
